text:
# filter.idIn

TL;DR:
- filter.idIn matches any of a provided set of exact listing ids.

What it means:
- It constrains the result set to known concrete listing ids.

Agent hint:
- Use it only when you already have multiple exact ids to inspect or rehydrate.
